Hi there,

Thanks for reaching out, and sorry for the confusion around these charges. Two separate amounts like $135 and $27 in the same month usually happen for one of these reasons:

- A plan upgrade or add-on purchased partway through your billing cycle, which is prorated and billed separately from your regular subscription charge.
- An additional seat or workspace added to your account.
- Your regular subscription renewal plus a one-time charge (e.g., extra storage or a paid add-on).

I'd like to look into your account directly to confirm exactly what each charge corresponds to. Could you reply with the email address or workspace name associated with your Loopwise account (if different from this one), and the last 4 digits of the card charged? That will let me pull up your billing history and confirm the details.

If it turns out this was billed in error, we'll issue a refund right away.

Looking forward to hearing back so I can get this sorted for you.

Best,
Loopwise Support
